details.title: Effects of lavender on anxiety: A systematic review and meta-analysis

details.reason: Small heterogeneous studies do not yet establish yoga nidra as a stand-alone treatment for anxiety.
Expressive-writing findings vary substantially by population and protocol; journaling is not a substitute for mental-health care.

details.title: Weighted Blanket Use: A Systematic Review

details.reason: Clinical guidelines advise against using sleep hygiene as the only treatment for chronic insomnia.
This is cause-dependent supportive advice rather than an evidence-backed treatment for undifferentiated nausea.
